content.short: What’sMinting.Live is a free analytics platform and NFT tracker with minting rankings, floor sweeps, new collections, and on-chain activity.
content.description: Since its launch in 2021, What’sMinting.Live has offered a free analytics platform that delivers actionable insights into Ethereum-based trending NFTs. The service surfaces minting rankings across timeframes from the minute to the hour and provides transaction and gas-price graphs to help gauge a collection’s popularity. Users can explore floor sweeps and new collections, track on-chain activity, and compare trends across the platform’s website, Discord, and Twitter channels.
content.meta: What’sMinting.Live is a free analytics platform and NFT tracker for NFT collections. Discover What’sMinting.Live and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
